title: AstralPrimitives strict generation profile
description: Closed, bounded subset of the wire schema for model-generated trees. No object accepts unlisted properties, every string, list and number is bounded, images, audio and download targets are host-resolved handles, and every actionable component carries a capability handle, an accessible name, a spoken form and a compact form. Generated trees must stay within x-astralprims-limits, which a schema cannot express.

x-astralprims-excluded.chat_history: produced by the host from stored chats
x-astralprims-excluded.diff: produced by tools from real file changes
x-astralprims-excluded.findings: produced by tools from a review
x-astralprims-excluded.theme_apply: changes the host theme, which a model may not do
